confirmed_facts.fact: Smartwatch SW-40, AED 899.00, delivered to customer 2026-10-27 17:45 UAE; return requested 2026-10-30, 2.6 days later, inside the 7-day electronics window (Return v2 applies).
Serial recorded at inspection and on the photo matches the dispatch serial SW40-60219.
Inspection records a broken strap pin with the watch body undamaged, consistent with the customer statement; photo shows the broken strap pin.
Weights: dispatch 0.46 kg, courier pickup 0.48 kg, warehouse received 0.47 kg.
Return parcel was sealed at pickup and the courier recorded delivery to the warehouse with a Dock 2 signature.

findings.description: The inspection (08:30 UAE) and the inspection photo (08:28 UAE) are timed before the courier delivered the parcel to the warehouse (07:10 UTC = 11:10 UAE) and before the WMS receipt (11:20 UAE) on 1 Nov 2026. No record shown settles which times are correct. This is a signal needing explanation, possibly a clock or entry error; it is not evidence of wrongdoing.

Warehouse inspection records a strap pin fault consistent with the customer claim; the fault is confirmed at inspection but the inspection timing is unresolved. Defect route (repair or replacement) is also available under Defect 1.1/1.3.

evidence.quote: Strap pin broken, watch body undamaged

policy_references.quote: Items returned for a fault are eligible for a refund or replacement within the window if the fault is confirmed at inspection.
Evidence conflicts and no record settles it: escalate to a returns specialist.

findings.rationale: The return is inside the 7-day electronics window, the serial matches and the inspection and photo show a broken strap pin. However, the inspection and photo times fall before the courier delivery and warehouse receipt, and no record settles this. A warehouse clarification request is drafted; a returns specialist should decide once the times are explained.
findings.uncertainty_note: Substance of the claim is supported by the serial, photo and inspection note; only the timing of the inspection record is unexplained. Cause of the timing difference is unknown.
